allow_large: Owner-approved 2026-09-29 for legacy clean-ups: the fix contract covers both the memory snapshot fallback and the SDK typing-event branch; pure deletions plus regression tests
done_when: The memory review snapshot is required in the type and its no-snapshot fallbacks are gone; the SDK always expects orderedEnvelope on typing events; tests updated

findings.body: This test creates and lists reviews through internal functions, then calls the renderer directly; it never exercises the required running API and Playwright user flow. Its valid-snapshot assertions also pass with the pre-change renderer, so restoring the removed fallbacks would not fail it. Existing CLI coverage mocks the API (apps/core/test/unit/cli/memory-review-command.test.ts:15). Add coverage through the required entry points that detects the snapshot-contract regression and include it in the repository test command; forge.toml:6 invokes npm test, which currently runs only unit and integration suites (package.json:86).
findings.title: Not done: End-to-end regression coverage for required memory review snapshots

findings.body: The new test meaningfully detects the removed compatibility behavior, but it only feeds handcrafted events directly into SessionTypingTracker. The completion contract explicitly disallows unit tests as an item's only proof and requires a running API, real database, and Playwright user flow. Add that coverage to verify observable typing behavior through the actual event-consumption path, and wire it into the repository test command (forge.toml:6 and package.json:86).
findings.title: Not done: End-to-end coverage for ordered SDK typing events

why: Two leftover code paths support data shapes the product no longer produces: memory reviews without a snapshot, and SDK typing events without ordering info
